ModMetadata.Name: Stationeers Methane Combustion Fix
ModMetadata.Author: yaskovdev
ModMetadata.Description:
This mod is a BepInEx plugin. [b]It requires BepInEx with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin to be installed (see Installation below).[/b]
[h1]Stationeers Methane Combustion Fix[/h1] Fixes incorrect methane combustion reactions to be chemically accurate.
Notes: [list] [*] Works with existing saves. The mod does not modify save files, so it can be safely enabled or disabled at any time. [*] Applies corrections at the reaction-definition level, so fuel allocation, consumption, and exhaust calculations use consistent stoichiometry. A correctly mixed welder therefore leaves no unburned fuel. [*] Can also correct the methane + oxygen fuel mixture in starting and respawn equipment. This feature is disabled by default. Enable PatchStartingFuelMixtures in the mod configuration. [*] Tested with the Gas Fuel Generator (GFG). Combustion reaches the expected 90% ratio. [/list]
[h2]Installation[/h2] [olist] [*] If you haven't already, follow the [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad#installation]StationeersLaunchPad installation guide[/url] to install StationeersLaunchPad and BepInEx. [*] Press [b]Subscribe[/b] above. StationeersLaunchPad will pick up this mod automatically on the next launch. [/olist]
[h2]Methane + Oxygen[/h2] Replaces the incorrect reaction: 2 CH4 + O2 -> 6 CO2 + 3 Pol
With the correct reaction: CH4 + 2 O2 -> CO2 + 2 H2O
Recommended fuel mixture: 33% methane, 67% oxygen.
Always enabled.
[h2]Methane + Nitrous Oxide[/h2] Replaces the incorrect reaction: CH4 + N2O -> 2 CO2 + 2 N2
With the correct reaction: CH4 + 4 N2O -> CO2 + 2 H2O + 4 N2
Recommended fuel mixture: 20% methane, 80% nitrous oxide.
Enabled by default. Can be disabled in the StationeersLaunchPad configuration window or in BepInEx/config/StationeersCombustionFix.cfg (BepInEx is located in the game folder, e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers).
[h2]Methane + Ozone[/h2] Replaces the incorrect reaction: 3 CH4 + 2 O3 -> 6 CO2 + 3 Pol + H2O
With the correct reaction: 3 CH4 + 4 O3 -> 3 CO2 + 6 H2O
Recommended fuel mixture: 42% methane, 58% ozone.
Enabled by default. Can be disabled in the StationeersLaunchPad configuration window or in BepInEx/config/StationeersCombustionFix.cfg (BepInEx is located in the game folder, e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers).
[h2]Optional: Starting Fuel Mixtures[/h2] The vanilla game's data-driven spawn recipes use a 67% methane / 33% oxygen fuel ratio. With the corrected combustion reaction, that leaves excess methane in the welder and can ignite oxygen-rich surroundings.
Enable PatchStartingFuelMixtures to change every exact 2:1 methane/oxygen mixture in loaded spawn data to the correct 1:2 ratio while preserving total quantity and pressure. It covers the built-in fuel tank, fuel packages, starting and tutorial welders, spawn-menu recipes, and compatible custom spawn data.
Disabled by default. Corrected recipes affect only equipment spawned afterward, so existing tanks and saved contents are unchanged. Restart the game after changing this setting.
[h2]Experimental: Hydrogen and Alcohol[/h2] The mod also corrects the hydrogen and alcohol combustion reactions. Alcohol is treated as ethanol (C2H6O). These are experimental and disabled by default. You can enable them individually in the mod config in StationeersLaunchPad.
[h2]Feedback[/h2] Contributions, improvements, suggestions, and comments are welcome.
GitHub repository: https://github.com/yaskovdev/StationeersCombustionFix
